texto: **Crier** (scream), **murmurer** (murmur), **chuchoter** (spoon), **s'exclamer** (exclaim) describe the tone: **Il crie que Léa veut partir** (shouts that Léa wants to leave).
**Implorer** (implore) asks for something with insistence: **J'implore Paul de rester** (I beg Paul to stay). It goes with **de** + infinitive.

The «de» preposition is missing to link to the infinitive.
Although used in oral language, the classic and formal regime rules «de» + infinitive with the same subject or dative.
«crier» present in third person singular.
It means «murmurura», volume opposite the cry.
It usually rules «de» + infinitive and means «suplica».
«murmurer» present in third person singular.
It means «yells», opposite the low tone of the murmur.
It means «exclama», a living and high tone.
